lead.event: Era Media plans to acquire a 29.88% stake in INET
lead.headline: DOOH plans to acquire 29.88% of INET for about Rp2 trillion
lead.blurb: The proposed purchase covers 6.68 billion INET shares from AKUN at Rp300 each, representing 29.88% of INET's fully paid-up capital. Era Media would buy through its 99.99%-owned subsidiary CNI, and the transaction requires shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting because it is classified as material. Funding includes Rp120 billion of IPO proceeds and an initial Rp1.88 trillion loan from controlling shareholder SII at about 7.5% annual interest. The deal is projected to lift Era Media's debt-to-equity ratio from 0.31x to 6.77x.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: INDF, ICBP, and LSIP allocate Rp2.25 trillion for share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: INDF, ICBP and LSIP allocate Rp2.25 trillion for share buybacks
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Indofood, Indofood CBP and London Sumatra each set a maximum budget of Rp750 billion, about 1% of paid-up capital, to dampen share-price volatility. London Sumatra's buyback is scheduled to run from 26 October to 31 December, while the other two will use adaptive timeframes following exchange clarification requests in early November.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: MEDC subsidiary issues USD300 million bonds due 2032
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MEDC subsidiary issues USD300 million bonds due 2032
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Medco subsidiary Medco Redwood Tree’s notes carry an 8.875% coupon and were rated BB- by Fitch and S&P Global and Ba3 by Moody’s. Net proceeds will refinance or repay existing debt.

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri reports Rp46.5 trillion net profit through October 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports Rp46.5 trillion net profit through October, up 19.6% year on year
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri attributed the increase to credit expansion and higher transaction-based income. Loans grew 16.5% year on year to Rp1,635 trillion, while gross non-performing loans fell to 0.97% from 1.02%.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Bank Mandiri's bank-only net profit through October rose 19.6% year on year.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset Sekuritas cuts Dayamitra Telekomunikasi’s price target by 12%
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae cuts MTEL price target by 12%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Dayamitra Telekomunikasi reported Q3 2026 core profit of Rp468 billion, down 14.2% quarter-on-quarter and equal to 69.3% of Mirae’s projection. Mirae attributed the shortfall primarily to general and administrative costs rising 22.8% year-on-year.

earnings_guidance.event: Krom Bank reports nine-month 2026 earnings growth
earnings_guidance.headline: BBSI reports nine-month profit up 25% to Rp157.91 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Net interest income climbed 67% to Rp2.13 trillion, while loan disbursements rose 46% to Rp11.66 trillion. Total assets increased 65% to Rp17.64 trillion. President Director Anton Hermawan said the bank would sustain growth through stronger risk governance, disciplined underwriting and measured credit expansion.

earnings_guidance.event: Tugu Insurance reports nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: TUGU reports 17.4% nine-month 2026 profit growth
earnings_guidance.blurb: Tugu Insurance's earnings per share rose to Rp139 from Rp119, while consolidated profit grew 6.5% to Rp525.62 billion. Insurance service results increased 17.2% to Rp602.04 billion on Rp6.73 trillion in revenue.

deals_control.event: CSIS terminates its planned acquisition of KDTN
deals_control.headline: CSIS ends planned KDTN acquisition as shares fall 6.30%
deals_control.blurb: Cahayasakti Investindo Sukses, Putrasakti Mandiri and Intan Perdana Sukses agreed with prospective buyer Ruby Mining to terminate the conditional sale agreement on 5 November, ending a deal signed on 22 April. KDTN closed at Rp238 on 6 November, down 6.30%, with a 186,491-lot sell queue below that price.
